children: South Korea's presidential office said President Lee Jae-myung will meet Khaldoon Al Mubarak, chairman of the Abu Dhabi Executive Affairs Authority, on Friday. According to Sina Finance, Lee will review progress in bilateral cooperation since his state visit to the UAE last November and convey greetings to UAE President Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan. Mubarak and Kang Hoon-sik, chief of staff to the South Korean president, are expected to discuss expanding cooperation in defense, artificial intelligence, nuclear power, space, and culture.

title: South Korea and UAE to Discuss Defense, AI, and Nuclear Cooperation
